title: The Horrifying Case of Gary Farris
description:
When Gary Farris was found in his own burn pile, it was quickly deemed a homicide. But who had it in for Gary "Big Daddy" Farris? His cheating wife, Melody Farris? Or his son, Scott Farris, who made some questionable decisions... 

🎙️ Exclusive Stories on That Chapter Podcast https://open.spotify.com/show/5LPqLzjZutoof7avsALbYK

comments.text: As someone with a trail cam, I can attest that deleting the footage is a completely normal thing to do. In fact, he probably just did it automatically without even really thinking he needed to keep it for evidence, since this was BEFORE they found the bones in the burn pile, and they had no reason to believe he was murdered at this point in time. The trail cams can only store so much footage, so anytime you check the footage and there's nothing to note, you just automatically delete it to make room to store more footage. Definitely just his daily/weekly habit and not suspicious to me at all. Feel so bad for Scott, like not only is his dad dead, but his mom is trying vehemently to pin everything on him. That's just gotta be soul crushing.
